title: Hearts as Food
description: This project adds hearts as food into minecraft that give you a health boost
body:
Welcome!
This mod adds a edible heart that when eaten will give hearts. It is craftable and the recipe for it is shown inside the gallery!

Why would you want to download the mod?
You should download the mod because it provides a new food that help you with extra hearts, imagine a situatuion where if you had a few more hearts you could've survived? The heart as food mod provides help for it!.

What does this mod add?
The mod adds an edible heart that when eaten gives more hearts for you to survive longer!
